nodes.description: Mapping of reflection balances _rOwned; primary accounting ledger updated in _transferStandard and _takeTeam
Nested allowance mapping _allowances written by _approve and read in transferFrom
Total reflections _rTotal reduced by _reflectFee and read by _getRate/_getCurrentSupply
Reflection tax fee percentage _taxFee, zeroed by removeAllFee and restored by restoreAllFee
Team fee percentage _teamFee, mutated by removeAllFee/restoreAllFee
Payable developer address _devAddress receiving half of swapped ETH
Payable owner address _ownerAddress receiving half of swapped ETH
Liquidity pair address set in startTrading and used as swap-source check in _transfer
Uniswap V2 router address used for swaps and liquidity operations
Guard flag tradingOpen set once in startTrading
Reentrancy guard flag inSwap set by lockTheSwap modifier
swapEnabled flag enabling automatic swap inside _transfer
Maximum transaction amount _maxTxAmount set in startTrading and setMaxTxPercent
Flag mapping _isExcludedFromFee that disables fees for privileged addresses
Constant total token supply _tTotal
Ownable _owner set in constructor, checked by onlyOwner, cleared by renounceOwnership
Private _transfer: checks max tx, triggers swap-and-distribute, then _tokenTransfer
Private swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps tokens for ETH under lockTheSwap
Private sendETHToFee: divides ETH balance and transfers it to dev and owner
onlyOwner startTrading: deploys pair, adds liquidity, enables trading and swaps
External collectToken: dev-only swaps contract balance and sends ETH to fee addresses
Private _tokenTransfer: optionally removes fees then calls _transferStandard
Private _transferStandard: updates _rOwned, takes team fee and reflects fee
Private _getValues: computes reflection and token amounts using tax and team fees
onlyOwner setMaxTxPercent: sets _maxTxAmount from a percentage
Public ERC20 transfer: calls _transfer with _msgSender()
Public ERC20 transferFrom: _transfer plus allowance deduction
Public approve: delegates to _approve with _msgSender()
Private _approve: writes _allowances and emits Approval
Private _getRate: divides rSupply by tSupply from _getCurrentSupply
onlyOwner renounceOwnership: emits event and sets _owner to zero
balanceOf view that converts _rOwned via tokenFromReflection
owner view returning the Ownable _owner
msg.sender / _msgSender() attacker-controlled caller address
block.timestamp used as swap and liquidity deadline
External call to router swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens
Native ETH transfer to _devAddress and _ownerAddress
External addLiquidityETH call forwarding the contract ETH balance
from address parameter of _transfer
to address parameter of _transfer
amount parameter of _transfer
tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth
amount parameter of sendETHToFee
maxTxPercent parameter of setMaxTxPercent
contractTokenBalance local computed in _transfer
contractETHBalance local computed in _transfer and collectToken
takeFee local flag computed in _transfer
spender parameter of approve

msg.sender is used as the spender for allowance deduction in transferFrom
collectToken requires _msgSender() == _devAddress, an authorization check on the caller
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner
owner() returns the privilege account derived from constructor msg.sender
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, making the swap time dependent
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth (external swap) while executing a user transfer
_transfer calls sendETHToFee which pushes ETH out before accounting completes
collectToken calls swapTokensForEth before distributing ETH
collectToken calls sendETHToFee to push ETH to dev and owner
swapTokensForEth performs an external router swap call
sendETHToFee performs native ETH transfers to external addresses
startTrading performs an external addLiquidityETH call with ETH value
_transfer finalizes accounting through _tokenTransfer
_tokenTransfer invokes _transferStandard after fee handling
_transferStandard calls _getValues to derive amounts
_transferStandard updates the _rOwned ledger
_getValues uses _getRate to convert token amounts to reflections
_taxFee feeds the fee arithmetic inside _getValues
_teamFee feeds the team fee arithmetic inside _getValues
_rTotal is read in _getRate via _getCurrentSupply for division
_tTotal is read in _getRate as the division denominator
_isExcludedFromFee determines the takeFee flag in _transfer
_maxTxAmount caps the transferred amount in _transfer
swapEnabled gates the automatic external swap inside _transfer
inSwap guard gates the external swap inside _transfer
uniswapV2Pair comparison conditions the swap path in _transfer
uniswapV2Router is the target of the external swap call in swapTokensForEth
_devAddress is the recipient of half the swapped ETH
_ownerAddress is the recipient of half the swapped ETH
startTrading assigns the uniswapV2Router state variable
startTrading assigns the uniswapV2Pair state variable
startTrading sets tradingOpen to true
startTrading sets swapEnabled to true
startTrading sets the _maxTxAmount limit
onlyOwner setMaxTxPercent mutates the _maxTxAmount limit
public transfer delegates to the private _transfer
transferFrom delegates to the private _transfer
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance
public approve delegates to _approve
_approve writes the _allowances mapping
renounceOwnership clears the privileged _owner state variable
onlyOwner checks _owner for setMaxTxPercent
onlyOwner checks _owner for startTrading

to is the recipient parameter bound in _transfer
amount is the value parameter bound in _transfer

amount is the parameter bound in sendETHToFee
maxTxPercent is the parameter bound in setMaxTxPercent

contractETHBalance is a local computed in _transfer

normalization_plan.reason: The from parameter only carries the sender argument of _transfer and has no independent semantic role
The to parameter only carries the recipient argument of _transfer and has no independent semantic role
The amount parameter is a scalar argument of _transfer consumed by the fee and ledger logic
tokenAmount is the direct argument of the external swap performed by swapTokensForEth
amount is the value that sendETHToFee splits between the dev and owner addresses
maxTxPercent is only used to compute the _maxTxAmount state variable in setMaxTxPercent
contractTokenBalance is a temporary snapshot inside _transfer passed to the swap routine
contractETHBalance is a temporary balance snapshot driving the distribution branch in _transfer
takeFee is a transient flag inside _transfer derived from _isExcludedFromFee
spender is only forwarded from public approve into the _approve allowance writer
